title: Guarded depth-first refit
carryForward: Baseline — expanded split-border stays the benchmark. Candidate 1 — guarded depth-first refit continues as an experimental challenger. It gained 533 net correct positions and removed 78 net extras on the archived 144 views. Dropped walls accounted for 28 previously correct positions on Arcade 1 and 27 on Terrace 1. Test wall retention and compare on active Combined V1 before promoting. The reporting tools landed on Floating.

actions.title: Test source evidence for block counter
actions.evidence: Exact visible full-block wall grids on 144 matched views (Archived comparison) changed strict correct positions by +14,107, extras by -6,547, strict placement F1 by +42.67 pp and strict position + material F1 by +46.83 pp. 10,191 visible positions remained missing after this intervention.
actions.hypothesis: A full visible face may constrain grid pitch and origin better than an internal texture repeat.
actions.test: Compare a bounded chooser over the saved grids, including the current grid, with exact visible wall grids on the same views. If proposals contain the right grid, test a source-only chooser. Otherwise test full-face grid proposals on other buildings.

actions.title: Trace every dense export to its grid seed
actions.evidence: 1 of 144 views had at least 900 extras. train-sawtooth1-cool-low-left had 917.
actions.hypothesis: A partial face, an internal texture repeat or a grid crossing a depth boundary could expand into many cells.
actions.test: For every flagged view, compare grid width and height with a complete visible face. Trace the seed, mask boundary and first unsupported exported coordinate. Test a source-only grid gate on these views and low-extra controls.

actions.title: Replay the dropped components
actions.evidence: 2 of 144 views switched to a component with no shared parent chart. On 2 registered swaps, 196 positions were gained and 55 previously correct positions were lost.
actions.hypothesis: Keeping a compatible neighboring wall may recover visible positions lost in a component swap.
actions.test: Trace one lost coordinate per dropped chart back through the grid and join. Replay keeping the prior chart when its visible edge fits the selected group. Count recovered and lost correct positions and added extras.

actions.title: Resolve the heading before comparing placements
actions.evidence: 7 of 144 views had a nonempty export with unresolved orientation.
actions.hypothesis: A viable heading may exist among the offered orientations.
actions.test: Use the checksum-matched heading chooser to identify recoverable views. Test source-only axis and texture cues on other buildings and compare against the current choice on resolved controls.

actions.title: Trace changed coordinates to their first lost handoff
actions.evidence: 2 registered review overlays with no dropped-component overlay contain 46 previously correct positions lost.
actions.hypothesis: Grid scale, parallel depth or ownership at a shared edge could explain different lost coordinates.
actions.test: Trace the visible owner of a lost coordinate through its grid, plane, selected chart and decoded placement. Replay the first differing handoff on a gain and a loss.

actions.title: Keep the recovered part and test the dropped wall
actions.evidence: 55 of 55 lost correct positions in these 2 reviewed views were owned by dropped charts. train-arcade1-cool-high-right / mask-2: 28 · train-terrace1-cool-high-right / mask-1: 27
actions.hypothesis: A dropped wall can have a usable grid while its attachment to the selected group is still unresolved.
actions.test: Keep the winning group fixed. Test attachment at visible shared edges, then decode and count recovered correct positions and new extras on other buildings.

actions.title: Trace first-writer ownership at shared cells
actions.evidence: 98 losing cell writes in 6 reviewed views. In test-twinspire2-earth-high-right, mask-2 lost [0, 0, -1] to mask-3.
actions.hypothesis: At a visible corner, the winning chart may assign a different face material or retain a displaced edge.
actions.test: At each shared coordinate compare the winner and losing face with the recorded visible owner. Trace selection, decoded material and the placement under the same translation before testing a corner rule.

actions.title: Check where split surfaces meet
actions.evidence: 6 parent masks in 6 reviewed views have multiple saved depth partitions.
actions.hypothesis: A grid may extend across a parallel plane at a different depth after splitting or attachment.
actions.test: Compare the split edge to frontmost pixel ownership; trace each proposed grid into the decoded export. Replay an offset change only where visible faces support it.

actions.title: Measure the independent relative joins intervention
actions.evidence: 280 / 760 oriented charts reached the selected group across 144 measured views. No matched independent reference replay for this handoff on the candidate was supplied.
actions.hypothesis: Adjacent visible edges may constrain the relative integer offset.
actions.test: Replace only this handoff with its recorded visible answer, include a no-op, rerun the same downstream consumers and score decoded correct positions, extras and material F1.

actions.title: Test source evidence for local heading
actions.evidence: Reference chooser on 144 matched views (Archived comparison) changed strict correct positions by +617, extras by -617, strict placement F1 by +2.39 pp and strict position + material F1 by +1.64 pp. 23,681 visible positions remained missing after this intervention.
actions.hypothesis: Visible axis and texture direction may distinguish the available headings.
actions.test: Compare a source-image heading choice against the current choice on unresolved views and resolved controls.

actions.title: Test source evidence for material assignment
actions.evidence: Exact at correctly placed coordinates on 144 matched views (Archived comparison) changed strict correct positions by +0, extras by +0, strict placement F1 by +0.00 pp and strict position + material F1 by +22.32 pp. 24,298 visible positions remained missing after this intervention.
actions.hypothesis: Sampling an interior patch of each projected face may disambiguate block IDs on correctly placed cells.
actions.test: Hold placement fixed and compare source-only material assignments on correctly placed visible blocks across buildings.

actions.title: Test source evidence for surface finder
actions.evidence: Exact native visibility masks on 12 matched views (Held-out test split) changed strict correct positions by +126, extras by +161, strict placement F1 by +2.28 pp and strict position + material F1 by +4.60 pp. 2,145 visible positions remained missing after this intervention.
actions.hypothesis: Grouping visible pixels by the source-image contour may preserve complete faces.
actions.test: Compare native visible ownership and openings, then rerun ordinary counting and assembly.

actions.title: Test source evidence for surface and depth separation
actions.evidence: Exact native masks and measured plane fields on 12 matched views (Held-out test split) changed strict correct positions by +35, extras by -318, strict placement F1 by +4.33 pp and strict position + material F1 by +15.64 pp. 2,236 visible positions remained missing after this intervention.
actions.hypothesis: Separating parallel visible planes before counting may prevent a grid spanning two depths.
actions.test: Compare each source-only split with native plane ownership and rerun counts, joins and export.
